name: blueprint_debug_cannot_halt_error
description: arming a breakpoint headlessly is refused: a halt would suspend the HTTP server too

error.message: this editor cannot render, so it has no Blueprint debugger to resume from: a breakpoint that hits enters Slate's debugging loop, which stops ticking the HTTP server and wedges the editor for good. Set it with enabled:false to arm it for a windowed session, use watches to read values without halting, or pass force:true if you accept the risk
